description: This Java class 'DatabaseDetective' checks if the OpenMRS database is empty by inspecting the database metadata and excluding known Liquibase tables.

classes.name: DatabaseDetective
classes.description: A utility class to determine whether the OpenMRS database contains only Liquibase tables or is empty.

methods.name: isDatabaseEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the database contains only Liquibase tables or no tables at all, indicating it is empty or uninitialized.
